aiAnalysis.suggestion: Verify the deployed backend exposes `/api/auth/login` on `https://api.secondacademy.com.br`, and check gateway/reverse-proxy route mappings, environment variables for API base paths, and the auth service deployment status.

aiAnalysis.rootCause: The health-check endpoint `/health` also returns HTTP 404, which strongly indicates the test environment is pointing at the wrong server or the backend deployment is incomplete/misrouted. A healthy API should expose a health endpoint, so this is not a transient test issue.
aiAnalysis.suggestion: Confirm the correct health endpoint for this environment and fix the deployment or routing configuration so `/health` resolves on the expected API host. If the endpoint was renamed, update the test to the canonical path.
